legend: The tumour is composed of loose fascicles of plump spindle cells with vesicular chromatin and scant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Note the collagenous stroma and prominent intratumoural plasma cells.
This cellular, fascicular example could be mistaken for a sarcoma. Note the prominent intratumoural lymphocytes.
Immunohistochemistry for ALK is positive in the tumour cells, reflecting the presence of an underlying ALK gene fusion.

Breast lesion without a well-defined border, consists of short interlacing fascicles of plump spindle cells with bland nuclear features, accompanied by scattered chronic inflammatory cells. Immunohistochemistry showed negative reactivity for epithelial markers, with spindle cells marked by SMA. ALK1 immunostaining is weak in some spindle cells. FISH showed ALK rearrangement, supporting the diagnosis of an inflammatory myofibroblastic tumour.
